AMENAJAMENT SILVIC Etapele de parcurs, conform Normeleor tehnice pentru amenajarea padurilor (O.M. 1672 din 07.01.2000 al MMAP).Documentarea si recunoasterea generala a terenului studiat.1. Lucrari pregatitoare. 1.1. Documentarea si recunoasterea generala a terenului studiat; 1.2. Documentare privind conditiile stationale; 1.3. Procurarea materialului cartografic (planuri, imagini satelitare); 1.4. Procurare date din amenajamentele anterioare; 1.5. Realizarea conferintei I de amenajare;Faze de executie.2. Culegerea datelor din teren. 2.1. Materializarea subparcelarului, materializarea parcelarului si subparcelarului in cazul pasunilor impadurite incluse in fondul forestier; 2.2. Pozitionarea si marcarea pe teren a bornelor martor amenajistice; 2.3. Descrierea parcelara:- culegerea datelor tipurilor de statiune si padure;- determinarea elementelor dendrometrice ale arboretelor; 2.4. Inventarieri statistice prin suprafete circulare (suprafata cercului 500 mp) pentru arboretele exploatabile in rand de taiere cu suprafata mai mare de 3,0 ha si consistenta de 0,4 sau mai mare sau prin piete de proba si velascopice pentru celelalte arborete, conform normelor tehnice de amenajare; 2.5. Inventarieri integrale pentru arboretele exploatabile cu consistenta de 0,1-0,3 sau cu suprafata sub 3,0 ha; 2.6. Masuratori topografice pentru subparcelarul din fondul forestier; masuratori topografice pentru parcelarul si subparcelarul de pasuni impadurite incluse in fondul forestier;

{"id":1305,"tenderTitle":"BIOMASS Instrument Receive Amplifier Subsystem (RAS)","tenderNumber":"17.DSFR.002","tenderDescription":"The BIOMASS programme was selected as the 7th Earth Explorer mission in
Spring 2013 at the User Consultation Meeting in Graz, Austria. The overall
objective of the mission is to reduce the uncertainty in the worldwide
spatial distribution and dynamics of forest biomass in order to improve
current assessments and future projections of the global carbon cycle.

The objective will be achieved by implementation of a P-band SAR mission,
providing global maps of forest biomass stocks, forest disturbance and
growth.

This notification of Intended Invitation To Tender concerns the procurement
of Receive Amplifier Subsystem (RAS) by Airbus DS GmbH as a Core team 
member of the Biomass project. The supplier selection will be made in 
accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.

The scope of this procurement covers the design, development (including the
required qualification activities), manufacturing, testing and delivery of
the RAS.

The Receive Amplifier Subsystem (RAS) routes and amplifies the received 
radar echo from the PAS to the CES at low noise for one polarisation. The 
envisaged architecture 1 and architecture 2 for the RAS is shown in the 
Specific Statement of Work (SSOW). The RAS comprises protection for the 
instrument, even if the Instrument is powered off. Degradation of the RAS 
and data unavailability in case of Radio Frequency Interference (RFI) is 
minimized by bandpass filters before or after the LNA, depending on the 
supplier solution after thorough analysis of Scenario 1 and Scenario 2. 

For the two polarisations available, the Biomass Instrument contains two 
identical RAS, one for each polarisation. For the accommodation and 
mechanical envelope of the two RAS on the satellite, the SSOW provides 
the necessary details.

A thorough analysis on the RFI, especially with, but not limited to 
different levels of RFI, image rejection, noise figure, damage levels, 
linearity and dynamic range shall be performed by the Tenderer. 

The Tenderer is requested to provide a detailed proposal describing both 
architectures. The proposal shall also contain for each architecture, the 
corresponding price breakdown supported by PSS forms, a schedule and a 
development plan. The decision to implement architecture 1 or 2 will be 
taken by Airbus DS GmbH / Satellite Prime not later than 6 months after 
the KO based on the contractor phase B2 tasks as described in SSoW.

In this framework, the present Invitation To Tender will be addressed to
economic operators (including those deemed to act as subcontractors) whose
registered office is established in such Member and Associated States
which, by the time of the Contract award decision, will be a participating
State in the ESA Biomass project. 

The following States are participating in the said Programme: Austria,
Belgium, Canada, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany,
Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland,
